locations.note: American journalist Jonathan Hunt comes to Eger to visit a friend and stumbles on the 1898 letters of the scientist Ábray, which send him through the town's streets on the trail of a time machine.
Jonathan climbs the castle on Ábray's trail, and in the time-travel scenes he stands on its walls during the 1552 siege.
Jonathan climbs the minaret for a view over the town and a clue hidden at the top.
In the Lyceum's observatory Jonathan uses the camera obscura to watch the streets below and spot where to go next.
Jonathan visits the house to learn how Gárdonyi's novel of the siege ties in with Ábray's letters.
Jonathan calls at the Turkish bath while working his way through Ábray's clues around the town.
